name: SoCo Collection
summary: South Coast Collection (SoCo) is Orange County's premier upscale lifestyle center featuring over 70 carefully curated interior design showrooms, furniture galleries, fashion boutiques, and gourmet restaurants. This open-air destination serves as the ultimate inspiration hub for decorators, designers, and creative professionals seeking high-end home furnishings and culinary experiences.
demographics: SoCo Collection attracts an affluent, design-conscious demographic with above-average household incomes, primarily consisting of homeowners aged 35-65 in the Costa Mesa and greater Orange County area. The trade area draws interior designers, architects, and high-income professionals seeking premium home furnishings and design services. Visitors typically engage in purposeful shopping trips for home improvement projects and design consultations, with strong interest in contemporary furniture, luxury home goods, and upscale dining experiences.
description: South Coast Collection (SoCo) stands as Orange County's premier destination for design and culinary excellence, offering a carefully curated experience that transcends traditional retail. Located in Costa Mesa's design district, this upscale lifestyle center brings together over 70 meticulously selected showrooms, restaurants, and specialty stores that cater to decorators, designers, chefs, trendsetters, and creative professionals. The center has established itself as the ultimate inspiration hub, featuring an impressive collection of interior design showrooms and furniture galleries alongside fashion boutiques and gourmet shops. SoCo's open-air layout creates an inviting atmosphere where visitors can explore high-end home furnishings, contemporary design concepts, and culinary innovations in a sophisticated setting. The center's commitment to quality and curation has made it a central shopping destination for those seeking to elevate their living spaces and lifestyle, positioning it as a must-visit location for anyone passionate about design, food, and creative expression in Southern California.
